1	# walker-vidiyum-mun-shriram-a: Vidiyum Mun (விடியும் முன், "Before Dawn")
2	
3	**CSYE 7270 Fall 2026 · current submission: Assignment 5, Shaders, Materials, and the Godot Shading Language (tag `a5`; see
4	["Assignment 5"](#assignment-5-shaders-and-materials-tag-a5)). The game began in Assignment 2 (art, sound and music);
5	Assignment 3 added Blender models.**
6	**Student:** Shriram Alagarasan · **Engine:** Godot 4.7.2.stable.official (macOS) · **Renderer:** Forward+
7	
8	A time-loop mystery at the last party on a rich family's illegally fenced beach on ECR, Chennai. You play Hari, a middle-class engineering student. Every dawn ends in tragedy and he wakes at 8 PM again, keeping only what he learned. This repo holds the **asset slice**: one playable 2.5D scene (Telltale-style 3D deck, generated cel-shaded characters) that proves the generated art, sound effects and music work together in the engine.
9	
10	## Started from
11	An **empty Godot 4.7.2 project**. GDScript conventions and the headless test pattern were borrowed from my Assignment 1 repo [walker-jumpman-shriram-a](https://github.com/ShriramAzhagarasan/walker-jumpman-shriram-a), which was based on [nikbearbrown/walker-jumpman](https://github.com/nikbearbrown/walker-jumpman) by Nik Bear Brown. No art, levels or characters from either are reused.
12	
13	## Run it
14	1. Install [Godot 4.7.2](https://godotengine.org/download) (standard build, no .NET needed).
15	2. Clone this repo and import once (this builds the `.godot/` cache, which isn't committed):
16	   ```bash
17	   GODOT=/Applications/Godot.app/Contents/MacOS/Godot   # adjust to your install
18	   "$GODOT" --headless --path godot --import
19	   ```
20	3. Run: `"$GODOT" --path godot`, or open `godot/project.godot` in the editor and press **F5**. It opens on the **title screen**: press **Enter** for the ~30 s intro (Enter skips a panel, **Esc** skips the intro), then the slice starts at 8 PM.
21	
22	## Controls
23	| Key | Action |
24	|---|---|
25	| **W A S D** / arrow keys | Walk (camera-relative) |
26	| **E** / **Space** | Talk, advance dialogue, pick a choice (W/S to move between choices) |
27	| **Hold T** | Fast-forward the night (×8) |
28	| **Esc** / **P** | Pause (music is muffled while paused) |
29	| **M** | Mute or unmute **music** |
30	| **N** | Mute or unmute **sound effects** |
31	| **R** | Restart from loop 1 (after the end card) |
32	| **Enter / Esc** | Title: start the intro / skip the intro |
33	
34	## What the slice demonstrates
35	- **Hari in 10 states**, one static generated image per state (idle, walk, talk, phone, notes, overhear, startled, keys, white-out, relief). He faces the way he walks (the image flips at runtime). Collision is a 0.28 × 1.70 m capsule.
36	- **A generated environment:** a white glass villa, Italian marble, the beach view with the rock shrine, the fence and village boats, a fire overlay, the SUV. **Generated non-player characters:** Manikandan (2 states), Advay, Krishna.
37	- **Five generated sound effects on real game events:** Amma's call buzz (loop start), clue chime (new knowledge only), keys (they change hands), dawn horn and screech (failure), waves and crows (safe dawn). Each fires exactly once per event (automated test).
38	- **Two generated music loops** (party dance music and village gaana) that crossfade as you walk toward the fence, thin out after 3 AM, muffle on pause, stop at dawn, and restart at 8 PM.
39	- **The core loop, once:** loop 1 earns two clues; loop 2 uses them to keep the car keys with Manikandan, and the end card follows.
40	- **A title screen and intro motion comic** (4 generated stills, story captions) that set up the story, then cut to 8 PM. It covers storyboard panel 1.
41	- **Loop 2 isn't a replay:** Hari wakes in shock and notices people repeating themselves word for word.
42	- **Readable when muted:** every sound has a visual twin (phone card, notes card, keys icon, headlights and white-out, sunrise).
43	
44	## Tests
45	```bash
46	"$GODOT" --headless --path godot -s res://tests/test_assets_present.gd   # every generated asset is present and well-formed (70 checks)
47	"$GODOT" --headless --path godot -s res://tests/test_audio_mix.gd        # music under SFX, ducking, N/M mute toggles (10 checks)
48	"$GODOT" --headless --path godot -s res://tests/test_sound_triggers.gd   # exact per-event sound counts over a scripted 2-loop run
49	"$GODOT" --headless --path godot -s res://tests/test_loop_logic.gd       # knowledge persists, flags reset, keys-safe prevents the crash
50	"$GODOT" --headless --path godot -s res://tests/test_slice_smoke.gd      # the 3D scene builds with all nodes
51	python3 tools/check/loop_seam_check.py                                   # music loop seams (needs numpy + soundfile)
52	```
53	These are the A2 suites, run without `--fixed-fps` on purpose: three of them measure wall-clock time (`Story._now()`)
54	and fail only when the frame rate is pinned (a known A2 limitation, kept out of A5's scope). The A5 tests run through
55	`scripts/run-test.sh` (section "Assignment 5" below). Results and the human playtest are in [TEST-REPORT.md](TEST-REPORT.md).
56	
57	## Assignment 3: three Blender assets (tag `a3`)
58	Three game assets built from Blender's basic shapes by directing Claude through the **Blender MCP**, then exported as `.glb` and shown together in `godot/scenes/a3_showcase.tscn` beside Hari's 1.75 m billboard:
59	  - **The SUV:** 4.60 × 1.90 × 1.70 m, 456 triangles.
60	  - **The rock shrine:** the sea goddess in relief, with a brass lamp; 1.20 × 1.00 × 0.90 m, 266 triangles.
61	  - **A fence segment:** wooden posts and ropes; 2.40 × 0.12 × 2.10 m, 108 triangles.
62	
63	  Each is at most 6 shapes. The final sizes come from brief revisions 2–3, which were driven by my inspection in Blender.
64	- **Versions:** Blender 5.2.2 LTS · Godot 4.7.2 · mcp-for-blender 2.1.9 · macOS.
65	- **Brief (committed before building):** [CHANGE-BRIEF.md](CHANGE-BRIEF.md), the "Assignment 3" section, plus `godot/tests/data/a3_brief.json`. Interface notes: [BLENDER-NOTES.md](BLENDER-NOTES.md).
66	- **Open the scene:** `"$GODOT" --path godot res://scenes/a3_showcase.tscn`. Drag or arrow keys orbit (including from behind and below), scroll zooms, 1/2/3 focus each asset, 0 shows all, H toggles Hari, L toggles labels.
67	- **Run the check:** `timeout 120 "$GODOT" --headless --path godot --script res://tests/check_a3_assets.gd --fixed-fps 60`, and its self-test `check_a3_selftest.gd`. Results: [TEST-REPORT.md](TEST-REPORT.md), section "Assignment 3".
68	- **Blender sources:** `blender/<asset>.blend` and the exact code Claude ran in `tools/blender/build_<asset>.py` (plus `export_glb.py`).
69	- **What this assignment added:** the three models and their sources, `scenes/a3_showcase.tscn` (with a flickering lamp light), the headless check `tests/check_a3_assets.gd` (**31/31 PASS**) and its self-test (**17/17**), and the A3 sections of every doc. My hand edit is in BLENDER-NOTES.md.
70	- **A3 film:** [claude-liam-vidiyum-mun-a3-gamedev.mp4](https://northeastern-my.sharepoint.com/:v:/g/personal/azhagarasan_s_northeastern_edu/IQA4dYF_0V_BSpYUUXYgVdkjAaIpfKV-HliF7n9IKG8jTEc?nav=eyJyZWZlcnJhbEluZm8iOnsicmVmZXJyYWxBcHAiOiJPbmVEcml2ZUZvckJ1c2luZXNzIiwicmVmZXJyYWxBcHBQbGF0Zm9ybSI6IldlYiIsInJlZmVycmFsTW9kZSI6InZpZXciLCJyZWZlcnJhbFZpZXciOiJNeUZpbGVzTGlua0NvcHkifX0&e=xe2yTl) (Northeastern OneDrive), 3840×2160, 30 fps, 4:21, SHA-256 `40e99c7d4e55ecb2b7e004f608e3c55bd43010fd8776b86c66e2f8ed66b3a91e`. It shows game source `81c1666`. Records: [youtube/claude-liam-vidiyum-mun-a3-gamedev/](youtube/claude-liam-vidiyum-mun-a3-gamedev/).
71	- **A3 known limitations:**
72	  - The assets are silhouettes, with no lettering on the sign.
73	  - The flame is static in the model; the flicker is a Godot light.
74	  - They aren't in the night slice yet.
75	
76	  Full list in TEST-REPORT.md.
77	
78	## Assignment 5: shaders and materials (tag `a5`)
79	Two shaders added to the night slice (`scenes/slice.tscn`), plus a hint experiment. The specification and Shriram's
80	predictions are in [CHANGE-BRIEF.md](CHANGE-BRIEF.md), written before any shader existed.
81	- **"The night is slipping"** (`godot/shaders/night_skip.gdshader`, `canvas_item`, hand-written by Shriram): while you
82	  **hold T** at night, Hari's phone status bar glows sodium orange, fading in over 0.25 s and out over 0.5 s.
83	  `ui/night_skip_driver.gd` sets `skip_amount` from `LoopState.fast_forward` and the phase, stepping by `delta`. The bar
84	  is now its own node (`ui/status_bar.gd`), so only it glows.
85	- **Marble deck** (`godot/shaders/deck_marble.gdshader`, `spatial`, written by Shriram with ChatGPT's help, disclosed in
86	  SOURCES.md): Poly Haven Marble 01 (CC0) as colour (`source_color`), roughness and an OpenGL normal map as data,
87	  world-XZ tiling, and 5 Inspector uniforms in 2 groups.
88	  - `materials/marble_dry.tres` (defaults) is on three deck floors.
89	  - `materials/marble_wet.tres` (roughness 0.3, specular 0.8: glossier) is on the strip at the pool's back edge.
90	- **Hint experiment:** `scenes/hint_experiment.tscn` shows one 3×1 grey strip (`tools/write_hint_strip.gd`) read with and
91	  without `source_color`. Captured 64/128/192 and 137/188/225, exactly as predicted.
92	- **Language notes:** [LANGUAGE-NOTES.md](LANGUAGE-NOTES.md), on `godot/shaders/standard_generated.gdshader`
93	  (a StandardMaterial3D converted in the editor; unused by the game).
94	- **Tests** (Godot on PATH; each writes `logs/<name>_<fps>fps.log`):
95	  ```bash
96	  ./scripts/run-test.sh test_night_skip.gd 30    # also 60 and 144: 33/33 each, real T presses, fades timed by delta
97	  ./scripts/run-test.sh test_materials.gd 60     # 156/156: hints, uniforms, materials, imports, formats, wiring
98	  ./scripts/run-test.sh normal_map_check.gd 60   # 11/11: curl-ratio convention check, calibrated on Floor Tiles 06
99	  ```
100	  Three mutations (deleted `;`, renamed uniform, removed `source_color`) each make their test exit 1. Results:
101	  [TEST-REPORT.md](TEST-REPORT.md), "Assignment 5".
102	- **Captures** (windowed, real renderer, scripted): `godot --path godot -s res://tools/capture_a5.gd -- <glow|hint|marble|sweep>`
103	  writes to `evidence/a5/` and prints measured pixels next to the predictions.
104	- **Docs:** [MATERIALS.md](godot/MATERIALS.md) (audit + review) · texture credits in
105	  [ATTRIBUTION.md](godot/assets/textures/marble_01/ATTRIBUTION.md).
106	- **A5 known limitations:**
107	  - Marble 01's normal map is very flat, so `normal_depth` barely changes the look (and the curl ratio is 0.637, not near 0).
108	  - The glow's on-screen contrast at full strength is 3.46:1. It passes 3:1, but it depends on the scene behind the
109	    semi-transparent bar.
110	  - The three A2 wall-clock tests still fail under `--fixed-fps` (unchanged, out of scope).
111	  - Opening the editor rewrites `project.godot`; this is restored after every session (TEST-REPORT A5.8).
112	- **Next step:** let the battery icon drain from orange to red as dawn approaches (Shriram's idea from the planning
113	  session), so the phone also warns how little night is left.
114	- **A5 film:** Brutalist `godot-gamedev` explainer (walker mode, Kokoro `am_onyx` "Liam" narration, local),
115	  3840×2160, 30 fps, **7:29**.
116	  - **Link (Northeastern OneDrive):** LINK-PENDING
117	  - **File:** `claude-liam-vidiyum-mun-a5-gamedev.mp4` · **SHA-256:**
118	    `fb0d6a3800f34e313c3bd62bb0ad86bc43f766a50552657474c1d986ab196e46`
119	  - **Game-source revision shown:** `bb2c156`. Later commits change only docs and film records:
120	    `git diff bb2c156 a5 -- godot scripts` is empty.
121	  - **Film records:** [youtube/claude-liam-vidiyum-mun-a5-gamedev/](youtube/claude-liam-vidiyum-mun-a5-gamedev/): beat
122	    sheet, prompts, fact check, evidence and QC. `./art godot-gamedev --check` **PASS** (35 files, 7 exact excerpts, 7
123	    code→result pairs). Gate V on the final candidate: 0 BLOCKER, 0 MAJOR.
124	  - **Text-legibility gate (GATE T):** it flagged three beats where the "text" is inside real captures: petals and the
125	    orange bar in the `skip_amount = 2.0` capture, chairs in the playtest screenshot, and the light gizmo in the editor
126	    screenshot. Changing those pixels would alter the evidence, so the film was compiled directly. Approved by Shriram;
127	    reasons and boxed frames in `_qc/GATE-T-OVERRIDE.md`.
128	  - **Known flaws:** in B09 one code line is half cut off at the bottom of the code panel; B15's panel keeps the
129	    toolkit's fixed "GDD · DOCUMENT EXCERPT" label over shader lines (its subtitle says "Shader lines, verbatim").
130	  - **Revision 2 of the film (2026-11-01, ~20:20):** an independent grading pass found that B00 and B01 called all three
131	    shaders "hand-written", which overstated authorship (two were written with ChatGPT's help; see SOURCES.md). They
132	    now say "three shaders", and the B15 footer was un-clipped. The superseded export (SHA-256 `613d4ed5…af8`) is
133	    not the submitted film.
134	
135	## Docs
136	[CONCEPT](CONCEPT.md) · [STORYBOARD](STORYBOARD.md) · [CHARACTER-SHEET](CHARACTER-SHEET.md) · [CHANGE-BRIEF](CHANGE-BRIEF.md) (A5; the A2/A3 briefs are in [design/briefs/](design/briefs/CHANGE-BRIEF-A2-A3.md)) · [DIALOGUE](DIALOGUE.md) · [ASSET-LOG](ASSET-LOG.md) · [SOURCES](SOURCES.md) · [FRICTIONAL](FRICTIONAL.md) · [TEST-REPORT](TEST-REPORT.md) · [MATERIALS](godot/MATERIALS.md) · [LANGUAGE-NOTES](LANGUAGE-NOTES.md) · my original story and decisions: [design/input/](design/input/)

139	- **2.5D:** characters, the SUV and the backdrops are flat generated images in a 3D deck, so they read as cards when the camera turns. Natural character motion would need rigged 3D models. **Next step, written for A2:** build the SUV, the rock shrine and the fence as Blender models (done in A3).

["Assignment 5"](#assignment-5-shaders-and-materials-tag-a5)). The game began in Assignment 2 (art, sound and music);
Assignment 3 added Blender models.**
**Student:** Shriram Alagarasan · **Engine:** Godot 4.7.2.stable.official (macOS) · **Renderer:** Forward+

No art, levels or characters from either are reused.

## What the slice demonstrates
- **Hari in 10 states**, one static generated image per state (idle, walk, talk, phone, notes, overhear, startled, keys, white-out, relief). He faces the way he walks (the image flips at runtime). Collision is a 0.28 × 1.70 m capsule.

## Tests
```bash

"$GODOT" --headless --path godot -s res://tests/test_audio_mix.gd        # music under SFX, ducking, N/M mute toggles (10 checks)
"$GODOT" --headless --path godot -s res://tests/test_sound_triggers.gd   # exact per-event sound counts over a scripted 2-loop run
"$GODOT" --headless --path godot -s res://tests/test_loop_logic.gd       # knowledge persists, flags reset, keys-safe prevents the crash
"$GODOT" --headless --path godot -s res://tests/test_slice_smoke.gd      # the 3D scene builds with all nodes
python3 tools/check/loop_seam_check.py                                   # music loop seams (needs numpy + soundfile)
```
These are the A2 suites, run without `--fixed-fps` on purpose: three of them measure wall-clock time (`Story._now()`)
and fail only when the frame rate is pinned (a known A2 limitation, kept out of A5's scope). The A5 tests run through
`scripts/run-test.sh` (section "Assignment 5" below). Results and the human playtest are in [TEST-REPORT.md](TEST-REPORT.md).

## Assignment 3: three Blender assets (tag `a3`)
Three game assets built from Blender's basic shapes by directing Claude through the **Blender MCP**, then exported as `.glb` and shown together in `godot/scenes/a3_showcase.tscn` beside Hari's 1.75 m billboard:
  - **The SUV:** 4.60 × 1.90 × 1.70 m, 456 triangles.
  - **The rock shrine:** the sea goddess in relief, with a brass lamp; 1.20 × 1.00 × 0.90 m, 266 triangles.
  - **A fence segment:** wooden posts and ropes; 2.40 × 0.12 × 2.10 m, 108 triangles.

  Each is at most 6 shapes. The final sizes come from brief revisions 2–3, which were driven by my inspection in Blender.
- **Versions:** Blender 5.2.2 LTS · Godot 4.7.2 · mcp-for-blender 2.1.9 · macOS.
- **Brief (committed before building):** [CHANGE-BRIEF.md](CHANGE-BRIEF.md), the "Assignment 3" section, plus `godot/tests/data/a3_brief.json`. Interface notes: [BLENDER-NOTES.md](BLENDER-NOTES.md).
- **Open the scene:** `"$GODOT" --path godot res://scenes/a3_showcase.tscn`. Drag or arrow keys orbit (including from behind and below), scroll zooms, 1/2/3 focus each asset, 0 shows all, H toggles Hari, L toggles labels.
- **Run the check:** `timeout 120 "$GODOT" --headless --path godot --script res://tests/check_a3_assets.gd --fixed-fps 60`, and its self-test `check_a3_selftest.gd`. Results: [TEST-REPORT.md](TEST-REPORT.md), section "Assignment 3".
- **Blender sources:** `blender/<asset>.blend` and the exact code Claude ran in `tools/blender/build_<asset>.py` (plus `export_glb.py`).
- **What this assignment added:** the three models and their sources, `scenes/a3_showcase.tscn` (with a flickering lamp light), the headless check `tests/check_a3_assets.gd` (**31/31 PASS**) and its self-test (**17/17**), and the A3 sections of every doc. My hand edit is in BLENDER-NOTES.md.
- **A3 film:** [claude-liam-vidiyum-mun-a3-gamedev.mp4](https://northeastern-my.sharepoint.com/:v:/g/personal/azhagarasan_s_northeastern_edu/IQA4dYF_0V_BSpYUUXYgVdkjAaIpfKV-HliF7n9IKG8jTEc?nav=eyJyZWZlcnJhbEluZm8iOnsicmVmZXJyYWxBcHAiOiJPbmVEcml2ZUZvckJ1c2luZXNzIiwicmVmZXJyYWxBcHBQbGF0Zm9ybSI6IldlYiIsInJlZmVycmFsTW9kZSI6InZpZXciLCJyZWZlcnJhbFZpZXciOiJNeUZpbGVzTGlua0NvcHkifX0&e=xe2yTl) (Northeastern OneDrive), 3840×2160, 30 fps, 4:21, SHA-256 `40e99c7d4e55ecb2b7e004f608e3c55bd43010fd8776b86c66e2f8ed66b3a91e`. It shows game source `81c1666`. Records: [youtube/claude-liam-vidiyum-mun-a3-gamedev/](youtube/claude-liam-vidiyum-mun-a3-gamedev/).

  - The assets are silhouettes, with no lettering on the sign.

  - They aren't in the night slice yet.

## Assignment 5: shaders and materials (tag `a5`)
Two shaders added to the night slice (`scenes/slice.tscn`), plus a hint experiment. The specification and Shriram's
predictions are in [CHANGE-BRIEF.md](CHANGE-BRIEF.md), written before any shader existed.
- **"The night is slipping"** (`godot/shaders/night_skip.gdshader`, `canvas_item`, hand-written by Shriram): while you
  **hold T** at night, Hari's phone status bar glows sodium orange, fading in over 0.25 s and out over 0.5 s.
  `ui/night_skip_driver.gd` sets `skip_amount` from `LoopState.fast_forward` and the phase, stepping by `delta`. The bar
  is now its own node (`ui/status_bar.gd`), so only it glows.
- **Marble deck** (`godot/shaders/deck_marble.gdshader`, `spatial`, written by Shriram with ChatGPT's help, disclosed in
  SOURCES.md): Poly Haven Marble 01 (CC0) as colour (`source_color`), roughness and an OpenGL normal map as data,
  world-XZ tiling, and 5 Inspector uniforms in 2 groups.
  - `materials/marble_dry.tres` (defaults) is on three deck floors.
  - `materials/marble_wet.tres` (roughness 0.3, specular 0.8: glossier) is on the strip at the pool's back edge.
- **Hint experiment:** `scenes/hint_experiment.tscn` shows one 3×1 grey strip (`tools/write_hint_strip.gd`) read with and
  without `source_color`. Captured 64/128/192 and 137/188/225, exactly as predicted.
- **Language notes:** [LANGUAGE-NOTES.md](LANGUAGE-NOTES.md), on `godot/shaders/standard_generated.gdshader`
  (a StandardMaterial3D converted in the editor; unused by the game).
- **Tests** (Godot on PATH; each writes `logs/<name>_<fps>fps.log`):
  ```bash
  ./scripts/run-test.sh test_night_skip.gd 30    # also 60 and 144: 33/33 each, real T presses, fades timed by delta
  ./scripts/run-test.sh test_materials.gd 60     # 156/156: hints, uniforms, materials, imports, formats, wiring
  ./scripts/run-test.sh normal_map_check.gd 60   # 11/11: curl-ratio convention check, calibrated on Floor Tiles 06
  ```
  Three mutations (deleted `;`, renamed uniform, removed `source_color`) each make their test exit 1. Results:

- **Captures** (windowed, real renderer, scripted): `godot --path godot -s res://tools/capture_a5.gd -- <glow|hint|marble|sweep>`

1	extends CharacterBody3D
2	## Hari in 3D: camera-relative walking on the XZ plane, a billboard image per state.
3	## Reads keys through Controls, reports to the logic only through Story's thin interface
4	## (player_x, set_moving) and shows Story.hari_state.
5	
6	const Spec = preload("res://logic/hari_spec.gd")
7	const Billboard = preload("res://scenes/billboard_art.gd")
8	const ART_DIR := "res://assets/art/hari/"    ## <state_lower>.png, e.g. idle.png, keys.png
9	const ACCEL := 9.0                           ## m/s^2: ~0.25 s to full walking speed
10	const DECEL := 14.0                          ## m/s^2: settles in ~0.15 s
11	const STRIDE_M := 0.42                       ## distance per walk frame (feet don't slide)
12	const BOB_M := 0.035                         ## step bob height at full speed
13	const BREATH_HZ := 0.28                      ## idle breathing
14	const BREATH_AMOUNT := 0.007
15	const TURN_SECONDS := 0.14                   ## squash when facing flips
16	
17	var _walk_frames: Array[String] = []
18	var _travel := 0.0
19	var _time := 0.0
20	var _turn := 0.0
21	var _facing_left := false
22	
23	var camera: Camera3D
24	@onready var sprite: Billboard = $Sprite
25	@onready var label: Label3D = $StateLabel
26	@onready var collision: CollisionShape3D = $Collision
27	
28	func _ready() -> void:
29		var capsule := CapsuleShape3D.new()
30		capsule.radius = Spec.CAPSULE_RADIUS
31		capsule.height = Spec.CAPSULE_HEIGHT
32		collision.shape = capsule
33		collision.position.y = Spec.CAPSULE_HEIGHT / 2.0      # capsule bottom at the feet
34		sprite.height_m = Spec.HEIGHT_M
35		for i in range(1, 9):                                    # optional walk cycle: walk_1.png, walk_2.png, ...
36			if ResourceLoader.exists(ART_DIR + "walk_%d.png" % i):
37				_walk_frames.append(ART_DIR + "walk_%d.png" % i)
38		add_child(preload("res://scenes/blob_shadow.gd").new())
39		Story.hari_state_changed.connect(_show_state)
40		_show_state(Story.hari_state)
41	
42	func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
43		var input: Vector2 = Vector2.ZERO if Story.movement_locked() else Controls.move_vector()
44		var direction := Vector3.ZERO
45		if camera and input != Vector2.ZERO:
46			var right := camera.global_basis.x
47			var forward := -camera.global_basis.z
48			right.y = 0.0
49			forward.y = 0.0
50			direction = (right.normalized() * input.x + forward.normalized() * -input.y).limit_length(1.0)
51			var screen_x := direction.dot(right.normalized())
52			if absf(screen_x) > 0.1 and (screen_x < 0.0) != _facing_left:
53				_facing_left = screen_x < 0.0                    # art faces right; flip when moving screen-left
54				_turn = TURN_SECONDS
55		var target_v := direction * Spec.WALK_SPEED
56		var rate := ACCEL if target_v.length() > 0.01 else DECEL
57		var hv := Vector3(velocity.x, 0.0, velocity.z).move_toward(target_v, rate * delta)
58		velocity = Vector3(hv.x, 0.0, hv.z)
59		move_and_slide()
60		position.y = 0.0
61		Story.player_x = global_position.x
62		Story.set_moving(direction != Vector3.ZERO)
63	
64	## Presentation-only motion: walk frames by distance, step bob, idle breathing, turn squash.
65	func _process(delta: float) -> void:
66		_time += delta
67		var speed := Vector2(velocity.x, velocity.z).length()
68		var k := clampf(speed / Spec.WALK_SPEED, 0.0, 1.0)
69		_travel += speed * delta
70		var walking := Story.hari_state == "WALK"
71		if walking and _walk_frames.size() > 1:
72			var frame := int(_travel / STRIDE_M) % _walk_frames.size()
73			sprite.set_art(_walk_frames[frame], "walk")
74		# low on contact frames (even), high on passing frames (odd): a step, not a float
75		var bob := (1.0 - cos(PI * (_travel / STRIDE_M - 0.5))) * 0.5 * BOB_M * k if walking else 0.0
76		sprite.position.y = sprite.height_m / 2.0 + bob
77		var breath := 1.0 + (sin(_time * TAU * BREATH_HZ) * BREATH_AMOUNT if not walking else 0.0)
78		_turn = maxf(_turn - delta, 0.0)
79		var squash := 1.0 - 0.55 * sin(PI * (1.0 - _turn / TURN_SECONDS)) if _turn > 0.0 else 1.0
80		sprite.flip_h = _facing_left
81		sprite.scale = Vector3(squash, breath, 1.0)
82	
83	func _show_state(state: String) -> void:
84		var key := state.to_lower()
85		if key == "walk" and _walk_frames.size() > 1:
86			sprite.set_art(_walk_frames[int(_travel / STRIDE_M) % _walk_frames.size()], key)
87		else:
88			sprite.set_art(ART_DIR + key + ".png", key)
89		label.text = state
90		label.visible = not sprite.has_art                       # state label only on placeholders
91

extends Node
## Game logic for the night: clock, loop counter, knowledge, per-loop flags and the timeline.
## Knows nothing about audio or about the 2D/3D presentation: those only listen to these signals
## and read the queries below. Story (dialogue/interaction) and Controls (keys) sit beside it.
## Every timeline event is latched by a per-loop flag, so it fires exactly once per loop.

signal loop_started(loop_index: int)
signal phone_buzz
signal clue_saved(clue_id: String)
signal keys_exchanged(from_holder: String, to_holder: String)
signal advay_arrived(took_keys: bool)
signal fire_glow
signal dawn_crash
signal safe_dawn
signal slice_ended
signal pause_changed(paused: bool)

enum Phase { NIGHT, CRASH, SAFE_DAWN, ENDED }

# Clock values are minutes after midnight of the party day, so 1:30 AM = 25 * 60 + 30.
const NIGHT_START := 20 * 60              ## 8:00 PM
const NIGHT_END := 29 * 60 + 55           ## 5:55 AM
const NIGHT_REAL_SECONDS := 180.0         ## real seconds for the whole night at 1x
const FAST_FORWARD := 8.0                 ## hold T
const MINUTES_PER_SECOND := (NIGHT_END - NIGHT_START) / NIGHT_REAL_SECONDS
const OVERHEAR_START := 25 * 60 + 20      ## 1:20 AM, Manikandan calls Selvam
const ADVAY_TIME := 25 * 60 + 40          ## 1:40 AM, Advay comes for the keys
const MUSIC_THIN_START := 27 * 60         ## 3:00 AM, party music starts thinning
const FIRE_GLOW_TIME := 28 * 60 + 45      ## 4:45 AM
const DAWN_TIME := 29 * 60 + 50           ## 5:50 AM
const CRASH_RESET_DELAY := 4.0            ## real seconds from dawn_crash to the 8 PM reset
const END_CARD_DELAY := 3.0               ## real seconds from safe_dawn to the end card
const KNOWLEDGE := ["KNOW_SELVAM", "KNOW_KEYS"]

var loop_index := 1
var knowledge := {}                       ## persists across loops
var notes: Array[String] = []             ## phone notes (clue ids), persist across loops
var flags := {}                           ## reset every loop
var clock_minutes := float(NIGHT_START)
var phase := Phase.NIGHT
var keys_holder := "car"                  ## car / manikandan / advay
var talking := false                      ## set by Story while a dialogue is open: freezes the clock
var fast_forward := false                 ## set by Controls while T is held
var running := false
var test_hold_clock := false              ## test-only: stop the clock from moving by itself
var _sequence_time := 0.0

func _ready() -> void:
	_clear_knowledge()
	_reset_loop_flags()

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	if not running:
		return
	match phase:
		Phase.NIGHT:
			if not talking and not test_hold_clock:
				var speed: float = FAST_FORWARD if fast_forward else 1.0
				_set_clock(clock_minutes + delta * MINUTES_PER_SECOND * speed)
		Phase.CRASH:
			_sequence_time += delta
			if _sequence_time >= CRASH_RESET_DELAY:
				start_loop(loop_index + 1)
		Phase.SAFE_DAWN:
			clock_minutes = minf(clock_minutes + delta * MINUTES_PER_SECOND, NIGHT_END)
			_sequence_time += delta
			if _sequence_time >= END_CARD_DELAY:
				phase = Phase.ENDED
				slice_ended.emit()

# --- loop control ---------------------------------------------------------------

## Fresh slice: loop 1 with all knowledge cleared (used at launch and by R on the end card).
func begin_slice() -> void:
	_clear_knowledge()
	start_loop(1)

func start_loop(index: int) -> void:
	loop_index = index
	_reset_loop_flags()
	clock_minutes = NIGHT_START
	phase = Phase.NIGHT
	keys_holder = "car"
	talking = false
	_sequence_time = 0.0
	running = true
	loop_started.emit(loop_index)
	phone_buzz.emit()

func set_paused(paused: bool) -> void:
	get_tree().paused = paused
	pause_changed.emit(paused)

func is_ended() -> bool:
	return phase == Phase.ENDED

## Presentation queries (pure).
func manikandan_on_phone() -> bool:
	return phase == Phase.NIGHT and clock_minutes >= OVERHEAR_START and clock_minutes < ADVAY_TIME

func advay_present() -> bool:
	return flags.ADVAY_DONE and phase != Phase.CRASH

# --- interactions ---------------------------------------------------------------

## Which conversation Manikandan offers right now. Pure query; changes nothing.
func manikandan_topic() -> String:
	if phase != Phase.NIGHT:
		return ""
	if flags.KEYS_SAFE:
		return "mani_keys_safe"
	if keys_holder == "advay":
		return "mani_after_advay"
	if ask_selvam_available():
		return "mani_choice"
	if clock_minutes >= OVERHEAR_START and clock_minutes < ADVAY_TIME:
		return "mani_overheard_again" if knowledge.KNOW_SELVAM else "mani_overhear"
	return "mani_generic"

## Hari talks to Manikandan. Returns the conversation id (changes nothing by itself).
func talk_to_manikandan() -> String:
	return manikandan_topic()

## Hari has listened to the whole Selvam call (Story calls this when mani_overhear closes).
## Saves the clue once; returns true if it was new.
func finish_overhearing() -> bool:
	return phase == Phase.NIGHT and _learn("KNOW_SELVAM")

func ask_selvam_available() -> bool:
	return phase == Phase.NIGHT and loop_index >= 2 and knowledge.KNOW_SELVAM and knowledge.KNOW_KEYS \
		and clock_minutes < ADVAY_TIME and not flags.KEYS_SAFE

## The "Ask about Selvam" choice. Manikandan agrees to hold the keys. Returns false if not allowed.
func ask_about_selvam() -> bool:
	if not ask_selvam_available():
		return false
	flags.KEYS_SAFE = true
	var from := keys_holder
	keys_holder = "manikandan"
	keys_exchanged.emit(from, keys_holder)
	_save_note("KEYS_WITH_MANI")
	return true

# --- test-only API ----------------------------------------------------------------

## Jump the clock forward to `minutes` and run every timeline event on the way, in order.
func test_advance_to(minutes: float) -> void:
	if phase == Phase.NIGHT:
		_set_clock(maxf(minutes, clock_minutes))

## Finish the running dawn sequence now instead of waiting for its real-time delay.
func test_skip_sequence() -> void:
	_sequence_time = 1000.0
	_process(0.0)

func test_setup(index: int, known: Dictionary) -> void:
	_clear_knowledge()
	for id in known:
		knowledge[id] = known[id]
	start_loop(index)

# --- internals --------------------------------------------------------------------

func _set_clock(minutes: float) -> void:
	clock_minutes = minf(minutes, NIGHT_END)
	if clock_minutes >= ADVAY_TIME and not flags.ADVAY_DONE:
		flags.ADVAY_DONE = true
		_advay_arrives()
	if clock_minutes >= FIRE_GLOW_TIME and not flags.FIRE_GLOW_DONE:
		flags.FIRE_GLOW_DONE = true
		fire_glow.emit()
	if clock_minutes >= DAWN_TIME and not flags.DAWN_DONE:
		flags.DAWN_DONE = true
		clock_minutes = DAWN_TIME
		_dawn()

func _advay_arrives() -> void:
	if flags.KEYS_SAFE:
		advay_arrived.emit(false)
		return
	var from := keys_holder
	keys_holder = "advay"
	advay_arrived.emit(true)
	keys_exchanged.emit(from, keys_holder)
	_learn("KNOW_KEYS")

func _dawn() -> void:
	_sequence_time = 0.0
	if flags.KEYS_SAFE:
		phase = Phase.SAFE_DAWN
		safe_dawn.emit()
	else:
		phase = Phase.CRASH
		dawn_crash.emit()

func _learn(id: String) -> bool:
	if knowledge.get(id, false):
		return false
	knowledge[id] = true
	_save_note(id)
	return true

func _save_note(id: String) -> void:
	if id in notes:
		return
	notes.append(id)
	clue_saved.emit(id)

func _clear_knowledge() -> void:
	knowledge.clear()
	for id in KNOWLEDGE:
		knowledge[id] = false
	notes.clear()

func _reset_loop_flags() -> void:
	flags = {"KEYS_SAFE": false, "ADVAY_DONE": false, "FIRE_GLOW_DONE": false, "DAWN_DONE": false}

2	## Keyboard -> logic. Polls actions with is_action_just_pressed, so a held key or OS
3	## key-repeat echo can never fire an action twice. Movement (camera-relative) is read
4	## by the presentation through move_vector(); everything else goes straight to the logic.
5	
6	const InputSetup = preload("res://logic/input_setup.gd")
7	
8	func _ready() -> void:
9		process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
10		InputSetup.ensure_actions()
11	
12	func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
13		var ls: Node = get_node("/root/LoopState")
14		var story: Node = get_node("/root/Story")
15		var sound: Node = get_node("/root/SoundBank")
16		if Input.is_action_just_pressed("quit") and ls.is_ended():
17			get_tree().quit()
18			return
19		if Input.is_action_just_pressed("pause") and not ls.is_ended():
20			ls.set_paused(not get_tree().paused)
21		if Input.is_action_just_pressed("mute_music"):
22			sound.toggle_bus_mute("Music")
23		if Input.is_action_just_pressed("mute_sfx"):
24			sound.toggle_bus_mute("SFX")
25		if get_tree().paused:
26			return
27		ls.fast_forward = Input.is_action_pressed("fast_forward")
28		if ls.is_ended() and Input.is_action_just_pressed("restart"):
29			ls.begin_slice()
30			return
31		if Input.is_action_just_pressed("choice_up"):
32			story.move_choice(-1)
33		if Input.is_action_just_pressed("choice_down"):
34			story.move_choice(1)
35		if Input.is_action_just_pressed("interact"):
36			story.press_interact()
37	
38	## WASD / arrows as a 2D vector (x = right, y = down/back), for camera-relative movement.
39	func move_vector() -> Vector2:
40		return Input.get_vector("move_left", "move_right", "move_up", "move_down")

# CLAUDE.md

## Project context

- **Engine:** Godot 4.7.2.stable.official.ed1daf0bf, macOS (feature `"4.7"` at
  `godot/project.godot:16`; `README.md:6`). **Renderer:** Forward+ (`godot/project.godot:38`).
- **Main scene:** `res://scenes/intro.tscn` (`project.godot:15`). The A6 effects live in the
  gameplay scene `res://scenes/slice.tscn` (root `Slice`, a `Node3D` at `slice.tscn:78`).

### Effect A — Sand scuff on footsteps

- **Node type:** two `CPUParticles3D` emitters (SoftDust, FineGrit) under one `FootstepScuff`
  root, instanced per footfall. `CPUParticles3D` was chosen because the scuff only needs
  gravity, damping, colour, and scale; `CPUParticles3D` in this build has no `amount_ratio`,
  turbulence or attractor (CHANGE-BRIEF §0).
- **Trigger owner:** Hari is a `CharacterBody3D` (`godot/scenes/slice.tscn:236`,
  `godot/scenes/hari.gd`). Walked distance lives in `hari.gd:11,69,72` (`STRIDE_M = 0.42`,
  `_travel += speed * delta`). Foot contact is `_travel / STRIDE_M` = 2k + 0.5
  (`hari.gd:74-75`), about every 0.38 s at `Spec.WALK_SPEED = 2.2` (`godot/logic/hari_spec.gd:4,7`).
- **No footstep signal exists today.** The trigger script must detect contact crossings itself.
  Gating uses `Story.hari_state == "WALK"` (`godot/autoload/story.gd:25,60`) and
  `Story.movement_locked()` (also respected at `hari.gd:43`). Pause gates come from the tree
  pause set by `Controls` on `pause` (`godot/autoload/controls.gd:19-20`;
  `godot/logic/input_setup.gd:13`).

### Effect B — Moths around the string lights

- **Node type:** three `GPUParticles3D` emitters with a `ParticleProcessMaterial`, each
  paired with a `GPUParticlesAttractorSphere3D`. Picked for `turbulence_*` and attractor
  interaction, which `CPUParticles3D` doesn't have in this build (CHANGE-BRIEF §0).
- **Scene the lights live in:** `res://scenes/slice.tscn` — the string lights (poles, bulbs
  and warm `OmniLight3D` per span) are built in code by `godot/scenes/deck_dressing.gd:11-13,42-46`,
  attached from `slice.tscn:91`.
- **Condition owner:** `LoopState.phase == Phase.NIGHT` (enum `godot/autoload/loop_state.gd:18`)
  and `LoopState.clock_minutes < 1740` (sky-lighten threshold, `godot/scenes/slice.gd:28`;
  clock written at `loop_state.gd:59`). **No signal fires at minute 1740** — the controller
  must poll each frame. Pause uses the tree pause (same path as Effect A).

### Tests (all through `scripts/run-test.sh`)

`scripts/run-test.sh <file.gd> <fps|realtime> [timeout-seconds]` runs
`godot --headless --path godot --script res://tests/<file>`, adds `--fixed-fps <fps>` when
`$2` is a number and omits it when `$2` is `realtime`, tees to
`logs/<name>_<fps|realtime>.log`, and exits 1 on `SHADER ERROR`/`SCRIPT ERROR`
(`scripts/run-test.sh:1-14`). Default timeout 120 s.

Current A2/A3/A5 tests in `godot/tests/`, with baseline counts (A6 baseline in
`logs/a6-baseline/SUMMARY.txt`):

```bash
# A2 — three use Story._now() wall-clock and need realtime mode; the others pass at any fps.
scripts/run-test.sh test_assets_present.gd 60        # 70/70 PASS
scripts/run-test.sh test_audio_mix.gd 60             # 10/10 PASS
scripts/run-test.sh test_sound_triggers.gd realtime  # 86/86 PASS (53/86 under --fixed-fps 60)
scripts/run-test.sh test_loop_logic.gd realtime      # 36/36 PASS (4/36 under --fixed-fps 60)
scripts/run-test.sh test_slice_smoke.gd realtime     # 13/13 PASS (4/13 under --fixed-fps 60)
# A3
scripts/run-test.sh check_a3_assets.gd 60            # 31/31 PASS
scripts/run-test.sh check_a3_selftest.gd 60          # 17/17 PASS
# A5
scripts/run-test.sh test_night_skip.gd 30            # 33/33; also 60 and 144
scripts/run-test.sh test_materials.gd 60             # 156/156
scripts/run-test.sh normal_map_check.gd 60           # 11/11
```

`harness.gd` is the shared base class; `a3_measure.gd` and `capture_a3.gd` are helpers, not
tests. New A6 tests (CHANGE-BRIEF §D) will run through the same wrapper and must use frame
`delta`, never `Time.get_ticks_msec()`, to stay fps-independent.

### Headless facts (confirmed on this machine)
- `godot` on PATH is a symlink, `/opt/homebrew/bin/godot` → `~/Downloads/Godot.app/Contents/MacOS/Godot`
  (4.7.2.stable.official.ed1daf0bf). The README's `/Applications` path is wrong for this machine.
- `timeout` is GNU coreutils at `/opt/homebrew/bin/timeout`. Exit status 124 means the test hung.
- Headless uses a dummy renderer that draws nothing. For particles it can read
  `can_process()`, `emitting`, `visible`, `amount`, `lifetime`, curves and material
  properties, but **never** the rendered picture. A `GPUParticles3D` is not GPU-simulated in
  headless. Every visual rule ends in a human check (windowed capture + in-game inspection).
- Never add `--rendering-driver` to the wrapper.

## Current change

@CHANGE-BRIEF.md

## Ownership

Files in `godot/shaders/` are hand-written by Shriram. An agent must never create, edit, or
rewrite any `.gdshader` file (including both A5 shaders and the hint-experiment shader) or
the one `COLOR` line inside `fragment()`. Agent sessions must leave
`git diff --stat godot/shaders/` empty. The hand-computed pixel predictions,
hint-experiment predictions, colour line, and Part 3 short answers inside `CHANGE-BRIEF.md`
(for A5) are also Shriram's and are not rewritten by an agent.

**A6 particle effects:** every per-emitter setting (emission, process, draw, turbulence,
attractor) lives in scene files under `godot/effects/` (`.tscn` + the `.tres` resources they
reference), **not** in code. Scripts under `godot/effects/` may trigger, position, show,
hide, pause and free those scene instances, and may read `LoopState`/`Story`, but must not
construct `ParticleProcessMaterial`, curves or ramps programmatically — the values from
CHANGE-BRIEF §A.3 and §B.3 belong in the scene.

## Godot 4 names

Use Godot 4 class and property names for 4.7.2. Not Godot 3 names.

- Particle process material: **`ParticleProcessMaterial`**, not `ParticlesMaterial`.
- Ranges: **`initial_velocity_min` / `initial_velocity_max`**, **`scale_min` / `scale_max`**,
  **`damping_min` / `damping_max`**, **`hue_variation_min` / `hue_variation_max`**.
  Setting the Godot 3 scalar `initial_velocity` or `scale` leaves the min/max pair at 0 and
  the scene still loads with no error (CHANGE-BRIEF §0).
- `scale_random` does not exist on `ParticleProcessMaterial` in this build.
- GPU particle node: **`GPUParticles3D`** (has `amount_ratio`, `use_fixed_seed`, `seed`,
  `preprocess`, `visibility_aabb`, `trail_enabled`, `sub_emitter`). CPU: **`CPUParticles3D`**
  (no `amount_ratio`, turbulence or attractor).
- Attractor: **`GPUParticlesAttractorSphere3D`** (`radius`, `strength`, `attenuation`,
  `directionality`).
- Material: **`StandardMaterial3D`** with `vertex_color_use_as_albedo`, `transparency`,
  `blend_mode`, and `billboard_mode = BaseMaterial3D.BILLBOARD_PARTICLES` (= 3).

If I am not sure a property name or enum value exists in 4.7.2, I will say so in the
response or in "Unconfirmed" below, not guess.

## Out of scope

The A6 change must not touch:

- Hari's movement, the 0.38 s footstep interval, collision, or input (`godot/scenes/hari.gd`,
  `godot/autoload/controls.gd`, `godot/logic/input_setup.gd`, `godot/logic/hari_spec.gd`).
- `LoopState` logic, phases, or the night clock rate (`godot/autoload/loop_state.gd`), and
  `Story` logic (`godot/autoload/story.gd`). Particle controllers may read these; they must
  never write them.
- Any A5 shader (`godot/shaders/`) or A5 material (`godot/materials/`), including
  `marble_dry.tres`, `marble_wet.tres`, and `night_skip.tres`.
- Deck dressing (`godot/scenes/deck_dressing.gd`), the string-light positions, the bulbs,
  or the warm `OmniLight3D` per span. Moths read those positions; they do not change them.
- Any existing test under `godot/tests/` or its expectations, and `scripts/run-test.sh`
  (diff it in every review).
- Any HUD element, dialogue, toast, white-out, or 3D object other than the new effect
  scenes and the small trigger script that instantiates Effect A.
- The known A2 wall-clock limitation in `Story._now()` (`godot/autoload/story.gd:203`).
- `godot/project.godot` renderer, display, physics, and autoload settings.

## Unconfirmed

- No `AGENTS.md` exists at the repository root.
- `godot/effects/` does not exist yet; it will be created when Effect A or B is first built.
- The A5 editor-rewrite caveat (`project.godot`, `default_bus_layout.tres`, scenes) is
  still assumed to apply to A6 editor sessions; restore with git after every session
  (TEST-REPORT A5.8).
- CHANGE-BRIEF's planned moth positions (x = 8, 12, 16) are between the pole x-values
  (6, 10, 14, 18) from `deck_dressing.gd:11`, not on the bulbs themselves. The brief flags
  this for a re-check before building.

  `_travel += speed * delta`). Foot contact is `_travel / STRIDE_M` = 2k + 0.5
  (`hari.gd:74-75`), about every 0.38 s at `Spec.WALK_SPEED = 2.2` (`godot/logic/hari_spec.gd:4,7`).

```bash
# A3
scripts/run-test.sh check_a3_assets.gd 60            # 31/31 PASS
scripts/run-test.sh check_a3_selftest.gd 60          # 17/17 PASS
# A5
scripts/run-test.sh test_night_skip.gd 30            # 33/33; also 60 and 144
scripts/run-test.sh test_materials.gd 60             # 156/156
scripts/run-test.sh normal_map_check.gd 60           # 11/11
```

`harness.gd` is the shared base class; `a3_measure.gd` and `capture_a3.gd` are helpers, not
tests. New A6 tests (CHANGE-BRIEF §D) run through the same wrapper and must use frame
`delta`, never `Time.get_ticks_msec()`, to stay fps-independent.

  (4.7.2.stable.official.ed1daf0bf). The README's `/Applications` path is wrong for this machine.

  properties, but **never** the rendered picture. `GPUParticles3D` is not GPU-simulated in
  headless. Every visual rule ends in a human check (windowed capture + in-game inspection).

@CHANGE-BRIEF.md

**A6 particle effects:** every per-emitter setting (emission, process, draw, turbulence,

they reference), **not** in code. Scripts under `godot/effects/` may trigger, position,

  or the warm `OmniLight3D` per span. Moths read those positions; they do not change them.
- Any existing test under `godot/tests/` or its expectations, and `scripts/run-test.sh`

# CLAUDE.md

## Project context

- **Engine:** Godot 4.7.2.stable.official.ed1daf0bf, macOS (feature `"4.7"` at
  `godot/project.godot:16`; `README.md:6`). **Renderer:** Forward+ (`godot/project.godot:38`).
- **Main scene:** `res://scenes/intro.tscn` (`project.godot:15`). The A6 effects live in the
  gameplay scene `res://scenes/slice.tscn` (root `Slice`, `Node3D` at `slice.tscn:78`).

### Effect A — Sand scuff on footsteps

- **Node type:** two `CPUParticles3D` emitters (SoftDust, FineGrit) under one `FootstepScuff`
  root, instanced per footfall. CPU is chosen because the scuff only needs gravity, damping,
  colour, and scale; `CPUParticles3D` in this build has no `amount_ratio`, turbulence, or
  attractor (CHANGE-BRIEF §0).
- **Trigger owner:** Hari is a `CharacterBody3D` (`godot/scenes/slice.tscn:236`,
  `godot/scenes/hari.gd`). Walked distance lives in `hari.gd:11,69,72` (`STRIDE_M = 0.42`,
  `_travel += speed * delta`). Foot contact is `_travel / STRIDE_M` = 2k + 0.5
  (`hari.gd:74-75`), about every 0.38 s at `WALK_SPEED = 2.2` (`godot/logic/hari_spec.gd:4,7`).
- **No footstep signal exists today.** The trigger must detect contact crossings itself.
  Gating reads `Story.hari_state == "WALK"` (`godot/autoload/story.gd:25,60`) and
  `Story.movement_locked()` (also respected at `hari.gd:43`). Pause comes from the tree
  pause set by `Controls` on the `pause` action (`godot/autoload/controls.gd:19-20`;
  `godot/logic/input_setup.gd:13`).

### Effect B — Moths around the string lights

- **Node type:** three `GPUParticles3D` emitters using a `ParticleProcessMaterial`, each
  paired with a `GPUParticlesAttractorSphere3D`. Chosen for `turbulence_*` and attractor
  interaction — neither is on `CPUParticles3D` in this build (CHANGE-BRIEF §0).
- **Scene the lights live in:** `res://scenes/slice.tscn`. String lights (poles, bulbs,
  warm `OmniLight3D` per span) are built in code by `godot/scenes/deck_dressing.gd:11-13,42-46`,
  attached from `slice.tscn:91`.
- **Condition owner:** `LoopState.phase == Phase.NIGHT` (enum `godot/autoload/loop_state.gd:18`)
  and `LoopState.clock_minutes < 1740` (sky-lighten threshold, `godot/scenes/slice.gd:28`;
  clock written at `loop_state.gd:59`). **No signal fires at minute 1740** — the controller
  must poll each frame. Pause uses the tree pause (same path as Effect A).

### Tests (all through `scripts/run-test.sh`)

`scripts/run-test.sh <file.gd> <fps|realtime> [timeout-seconds]` runs
`godot --headless --path godot --script res://tests/<file>`, adds `--fixed-fps <fps>` when
`$2` is a number and omits it when `$2` is `realtime`; tees to
`logs/<name>_<fps|realtime>.log` and exits 1 on `SHADER ERROR` or `SCRIPT ERROR`
(`scripts/run-test.sh:1-14`). Default timeout 120 s.

```bash

scripts/run-test.sh test_slice_smoke.gd realtime     # 13/13   (4/13  under --fixed-fps 60)
```
```bash
# A3                                                 # A5

```

# CLAUDE.md

## Project context

- **Engine:** Godot 4.7.2.stable.official.ed1daf0bf, macOS (feature `"4.7"` at
  `godot/project.godot:16`; `README.md:6`). **Renderer:** Forward+ (`godot/project.godot:38`).
- **Main scene:** `res://scenes/intro.tscn` (`project.godot:15`). The A6 effects live in the
  gameplay scene `res://scenes/slice.tscn` (root `Slice`, `Node3D` at `slice.tscn:78`).

### Effect A — Sand scuff on footsteps

- **Node type:** two `CPUParticles3D` emitters (SoftDust, FineGrit) under one `FootstepScuff`
  root, instanced per footfall. CPU is chosen because the scuff only needs gravity, damping,
  colour, and scale; `CPUParticles3D` in this build has no `amount_ratio`, turbulence, or
  attractor (CHANGE-BRIEF §0).
- **Trigger owner:** Hari is a `CharacterBody3D` (`godot/scenes/slice.tscn:236`,
  `godot/scenes/hari.gd`). Walked distance lives in `hari.gd:11,69,72` (`STRIDE_M = 0.42`,
  `_travel += speed * delta`). Foot contact is `_travel / STRIDE_M` = 2k + 0.5
  (`hari.gd:74-75`), about every 0.38 s at `WALK_SPEED = 2.2` (`godot/logic/hari_spec.gd:4,7`).
- **No footstep signal exists today.** The trigger must detect contact crossings itself.
  Gating reads `Story.hari_state == "WALK"` (`godot/autoload/story.gd:25,60`) and
  `Story.movement_locked()` (also respected at `hari.gd:43`). Pause comes from the tree
  pause set by `Controls` on the `pause` action (`godot/autoload/controls.gd:19-20`;
  `godot/logic/input_setup.gd:13`).

### Effect B — Moths around the string lights

- **Node type:** three `GPUParticles3D` emitters using a `ParticleProcessMaterial`, each
  paired with a `GPUParticlesAttractorSphere3D`. Chosen for `turbulence_*` and attractor
  interaction — neither is on `CPUParticles3D` in this build (CHANGE-BRIEF §0).
- **Scene the lights live in:** `res://scenes/slice.tscn`. String lights (poles, bulbs,
  warm `OmniLight3D` per span) are built in code by `godot/scenes/deck_dressing.gd:11-13,42-46`,
  attached from `slice.tscn:91`.
- **Condition owner:** `LoopState.phase == Phase.NIGHT` (enum `godot/autoload/loop_state.gd:18`)
  and `LoopState.clock_minutes < 1740` (sky-lighten threshold, `godot/scenes/slice.gd:28`;
  clock written at `loop_state.gd:59`). **No signal fires at minute 1740** — the controller
  must poll each frame. Pause uses the tree pause (same path as Effect A).

### Tests (all through `scripts/run-test.sh`)

`scripts/run-test.sh <file.gd> <fps|realtime> [timeout-seconds]` runs
`godot --headless --path godot --script res://tests/<file>`, adds `--fixed-fps <fps>` when
`$2` is a number and omits it when `$2` is `realtime`; tees to
`logs/<name>_<fps|realtime>.log` and exits 1 on `SHADER ERROR` or `SCRIPT ERROR`
(`scripts/run-test.sh:1-14`). Default timeout 120 s.

Current tests in `godot/tests/` (A6 baseline: `logs/a6-baseline/SUMMARY.txt`):

```bash
# A2 — test_sound_triggers / test_loop_logic / test_slice_smoke read Story._now() wall-clock
# and need realtime; others pass at any fps.
scripts/run-test.sh test_assets_present.gd 60        # 70/70
scripts/run-test.sh test_audio_mix.gd 60             # 10/10
scripts/run-test.sh test_sound_triggers.gd realtime  # 86/86   (53/86 under --fixed-fps 60)
scripts/run-test.sh test_loop_logic.gd realtime      # 36/36   (4/36  under --fixed-fps 60)
scripts/run-test.sh test_slice_smoke.gd realtime     # 13/13   (4/13  under --fixed-fps 60)
# A3                                                 # A5
scripts/run-test.sh check_a3_assets.gd 60    # 31/31   scripts/run-test.sh test_night_skip.gd 30  # 33/33 (also 60, 144)
scripts/run-test.sh check_a3_selftest.gd 60  # 17/17   scripts/run-test.sh test_materials.gd 60   # 156/156
                                                      scripts/run-test.sh normal_map_check.gd 60 # 11/11
```

`harness.gd` is the shared base class; `a3_measure.gd` and `capture_a3.gd` are helpers, not
tests. New A6 tests (CHANGE-BRIEF §D) run through the same wrapper and must use frame
`delta`, never `Time.get_ticks_msec()`, to stay fps-independent.

### Headless facts (confirmed on this machine)
- `godot` on PATH: `/opt/homebrew/bin/godot` → `~/Downloads/Godot.app/Contents/MacOS/Godot`
  (4.7.2.stable.official.ed1daf0bf). The README's `/Applications` path is wrong here.
  `timeout` is GNU coreutils at `/opt/homebrew/bin/timeout` (exit 124 = hung).
- Headless uses a dummy renderer. It can read `can_process()`, `emitting`, `visible`,
  `amount`, `lifetime`, curves, and material properties, but **never** the rendered picture;
  `GPUParticles3D` is not GPU-simulated in headless. Every visual rule ends in a human check
  (windowed capture + in-game inspection). Never add `--rendering-driver` to the wrapper.

## Current change

@CHANGE-BRIEF.md

## Ownership

Files in `godot/shaders/` are hand-written by Shriram. An agent must never create, edit, or
rewrite any `.gdshader` file (including both A5 shaders and the hint-experiment shader) or
the one `COLOR` line inside `fragment()`. Agent sessions must leave
`git diff --stat godot/shaders/` empty. The hand-computed pixel predictions, hint-experiment
predictions, colour line, and Part 3 short answers in `CHANGE-BRIEF.md` (for A5) are also
Shriram's and are not rewritten by an agent.

**A6 particle effects:** every per-emitter setting (emission, process, draw, turbulence,
attractor) lives in scene files under `godot/effects/` (`.tscn` plus the `.tres` resources
they reference), **not** in code. Scripts under `godot/effects/` may trigger, position, show,
hide, pause and free those scene instances, and may read `LoopState`/`Story`, but must not
construct `ParticleProcessMaterial`, curves, or ramps programmatically — the values from
CHANGE-BRIEF §A.3 and §B.3 belong in the scene.

## Godot 4 names

Use Godot 4 class and property names for 4.7.2, not Godot 3 names.

- **`ParticleProcessMaterial`**, not `ParticlesMaterial`. Ranges are min/max pairs:
  `initial_velocity_min/_max`, `scale_min/_max`, `damping_min/_max`, `hue_variation_min/_max`.
  Setting the Godot 3 scalar `initial_velocity` or `scale` leaves the min/max at 0 and the
  scene still loads silently (CHANGE-BRIEF §0). `scale_random` doesn't exist here.
- GPU node: **`GPUParticles3D`** (`amount_ratio`, `use_fixed_seed`, `seed`, `preprocess`,
  `visibility_aabb`, `trail_enabled`, `sub_emitter`). CPU: **`CPUParticles3D`** (no
  `amount_ratio`, turbulence, or attractor). Attractor: **`GPUParticlesAttractorSphere3D`**
  (`radius`, `strength`, `attenuation`, `directionality`).
- Material: **`StandardMaterial3D`** with `vertex_color_use_as_albedo`, `transparency`,
  `blend_mode`, `billboard_mode = BaseMaterial3D.BILLBOARD_PARTICLES` (= 3).

If I am unsure a property or enum exists in 4.7.2, I will say so in the response or in
"Unconfirmed" — not guess.

- `LoopState` (`godot/autoload/loop_state.gd`) and `Story` (`godot/autoload/story.gd`)
  logic, phases, or the night clock rate. Particle controllers may read these; they must
  never write them.
- Any A5 shader (`godot/shaders/`) or A5 material under `godot/materials/`
  (`marble_dry.tres`, `marble_wet.tres`, `night_skip.tres`).
- `godot/scenes/deck_dressing.gd`, the string-light positions, the bulbs, or the warm
  `OmniLight3D` per span. Moths read those positions; they do not change them.
- Any existing test under `godot/tests/` or its expectations, and `scripts/run-test.sh`
  (diff it in every review).
- Any HUD element, dialogue, toast, white-out, or 3D object other than the new effect
  scenes and the small trigger script that instantiates Effect A.
- The known A2 wall-clock limitation in `Story._now()` (`godot/autoload/story.gd:203`).
- `godot/project.godot` renderer, display, physics, and autoload settings.

# CLAUDE.md

## Project context

- **Engine:** Godot 4.7.2.stable.official.ed1daf0bf, macOS (feature `"4.7"` at
  `godot/project.godot:16`; `README.md:6`). **Renderer:** Forward+ (`godot/project.godot:38`).
- **Main scene:** `res://scenes/intro.tscn` (`project.godot:15`). The A6 effects live in the
  gameplay scene `res://scenes/slice.tscn` (root `Slice`, `Node3D` at `slice.tscn:78`).

### Effect A — Sand scuff on footsteps

- **Node type:** two `CPUParticles3D` emitters (SoftDust, FineGrit) under a `FootstepScuff`
  root, instanced per footfall. CPU, because the scuff only needs gravity, damping, colour,
  and scale, and `CPUParticles3D` in this build has no `amount_ratio`, turbulence, or
  attractor (CHANGE-BRIEF §0).
- **Trigger owner:** Hari is a `CharacterBody3D` (`slice.tscn:236`, `godot/scenes/hari.gd`).
  Walked distance lives in `hari.gd:11,69,72` (`STRIDE_M = 0.42`, `_travel += speed * delta`).
  Foot contact is `_travel / STRIDE_M` = 2k + 0.5 (`hari.gd:74-75`), about every 0.38 s at
  `WALK_SPEED = 2.2` (`godot/logic/hari_spec.gd:4,7`).
- **No footstep signal exists today** — the trigger script must detect contact crossings
  itself. Gate on `Story.hari_state == "WALK"` (`godot/autoload/story.gd:25,60`) and
  `Story.movement_locked()` (respected at `hari.gd:43`); pause comes from the tree pause
  set by `Controls` on `pause` (`godot/autoload/controls.gd:19-20`;
  `godot/logic/input_setup.gd:13`).

### Effect B — Moths around the string lights

- **Node type:** three `GPUParticles3D` emitters using a `ParticleProcessMaterial`, each
  paired with a `GPUParticlesAttractorSphere3D`. Chosen for `turbulence_*` and attractor
  interaction, which `CPUParticles3D` lacks here (CHANGE-BRIEF §0).
- **Scene:** `res://scenes/slice.tscn`. The string lights (poles, bulbs, one warm
  `OmniLight3D` per span) are built in code by `godot/scenes/deck_dressing.gd:11-13,42-46`,
  attached from `slice.tscn:91`.
- **Condition owner:** `LoopState.phase == Phase.NIGHT` (enum
  `godot/autoload/loop_state.gd:18`) and `LoopState.clock_minutes < 1740` (sky-lighten
  threshold, `godot/scenes/slice.gd:28`; clock written at `loop_state.gd:59`). **No signal
  fires at minute 1740** — the controller must poll each frame. Pause uses the tree pause.

### Tests (all through `scripts/run-test.sh`)

`scripts/run-test.sh <file.gd> <fps|realtime> [timeout-seconds]` runs
`godot --headless --path godot --script res://tests/<file>`, adds `--fixed-fps <fps>` when
`$2` is a number and omits it when `$2` is `realtime`; tees to
`logs/<name>_<fps|realtime>.log` and exits 1 on `SHADER ERROR` or `SCRIPT ERROR`
(`scripts/run-test.sh:1-14`). Default timeout 120 s.

Current tests in `godot/tests/` (A6 baseline: `logs/a6-baseline/SUMMARY.txt`):

```bash
# A2 — test_sound_triggers / test_loop_logic / test_slice_smoke read Story._now() wall-clock
# and need realtime; others pass at any fps.
scripts/run-test.sh test_assets_present.gd 60        # 70/70
scripts/run-test.sh test_audio_mix.gd 60             # 10/10
scripts/run-test.sh test_sound_triggers.gd realtime  # 86/86   (53/86 under --fixed-fps 60)
scripts/run-test.sh test_loop_logic.gd realtime      # 36/36   (4/36  under --fixed-fps 60)
scripts/run-test.sh test_slice_smoke.gd realtime     # 13/13   (4/13  under --fixed-fps 60)
# A3                                                 # A5
scripts/run-test.sh check_a3_assets.gd 60    # 31/31   scripts/run-test.sh test_night_skip.gd 30  # 33/33 (also 60, 144)
scripts/run-test.sh check_a3_selftest.gd 60  # 17/17   scripts/run-test.sh test_materials.gd 60   # 156/156
                                                      scripts/run-test.sh normal_map_check.gd 60 # 11/11
```

`harness.gd` is the shared base class; `a3_measure.gd` and `capture_a3.gd` are helpers, not
tests. New A6 tests (CHANGE-BRIEF §D) run through the same wrapper and must use frame
`delta`, never `Time.get_ticks_msec()`, to stay fps-independent.

### Headless facts (confirmed on this machine)
- `godot` on PATH: `/opt/homebrew/bin/godot` → `~/Downloads/Godot.app/Contents/MacOS/Godot`
  (4.7.2.stable.official.ed1daf0bf). The README's `/Applications` path is wrong here.
  `timeout` is GNU coreutils at `/opt/homebrew/bin/timeout` (exit 124 = hung).
- Headless uses a dummy renderer. It can read `can_process()`, `emitting`, `visible`,
  `amount`, `lifetime`, curves, and material properties, but **never** the rendered picture;
  `GPUParticles3D` is not GPU-simulated. Every visual rule ends in a human check (windowed
  capture + in-game inspection). Never add `--rendering-driver` to the wrapper.

## Current change

@CHANGE-BRIEF.md

## Ownership

Files in `godot/shaders/` are hand-written by Shriram. An agent must never create, edit, or
rewrite any `.gdshader` file (including both A5 shaders and the hint-experiment shader) or
the one `COLOR` line inside `fragment()`. Agent sessions must leave
`git diff --stat godot/shaders/` empty. The hand-computed pixel predictions, hint-experiment
predictions, colour line, and Part 3 short answers in `CHANGE-BRIEF.md` (for A5) are also
Shriram's and are not rewritten by an agent.

**A6 particle effects:** every per-emitter setting (emission, process, draw, turbulence,
attractor) lives in scene files under `godot/effects/` (`.tscn` plus the `.tres` resources
they reference), **not** in code. Scripts under `godot/effects/` may trigger, position, show,
hide, pause and free those scene instances, and may read `LoopState`/`Story`, but must not
construct `ParticleProcessMaterial`, curves, or ramps programmatically — the values from
CHANGE-BRIEF §A.3 and §B.3 belong in the scene.

## Godot 4 names

Use Godot 4 class and property names for 4.7.2, not Godot 3 names.

- **`ParticleProcessMaterial`**, not `ParticlesMaterial`. Ranges are min/max pairs:
  `initial_velocity_min/_max`, `scale_min/_max`, `damping_min/_max`, `hue_variation_min/_max`.
  Setting the Godot 3 scalar `initial_velocity` or `scale` leaves the min/max at 0 and the
  scene still loads silently (CHANGE-BRIEF §0). `scale_random` doesn't exist here.
- GPU node: **`GPUParticles3D`** (`amount_ratio`, `use_fixed_seed`, `seed`, `preprocess`,
  `visibility_aabb`, `trail_enabled`, `sub_emitter`). CPU: **`CPUParticles3D`** (no
  `amount_ratio`, turbulence, or attractor). Attractor: **`GPUParticlesAttractorSphere3D`**
  (`radius`, `strength`, `attenuation`, `directionality`).
- Material: **`StandardMaterial3D`** with `vertex_color_use_as_albedo`, `transparency`,
  `blend_mode`, `billboard_mode = BaseMaterial3D.BILLBOARD_PARTICLES` (= 3).

If I am unsure a property or enum exists in 4.7.2, I will say so in the response or in
"Unconfirmed" — not guess.

## Out of scope

The A6 change must not touch:

- Hari's movement, the 0.38 s footstep interval, collision, or input (`godot/scenes/hari.gd`,
  `godot/autoload/controls.gd`, `godot/logic/input_setup.gd`, `godot/logic/hari_spec.gd`).
- `LoopState` (`godot/autoload/loop_state.gd`) and `Story` (`godot/autoload/story.gd`)
  logic, phases, or the night clock rate. Particle controllers read these; they never write.
- Any A5 shader (`godot/shaders/`) or A5 material (`godot/materials/marble_dry.tres`,
  `marble_wet.tres`, `night_skip.tres`).
- `godot/scenes/deck_dressing.gd`, the string-light positions, bulbs, or warm `OmniLight3D`.
  Moths read those positions; they do not change them.
- Any existing test under `godot/tests/` or its expectations; `scripts/run-test.sh` (diff
  in every review); the known A2 wall-clock limitation in `Story._now()` (`story.gd:203`).
- Any HUD element, dialogue, toast, white-out, or 3D object other than the new effect
  scenes and the small trigger script that instantiates Effect A.
- `godot/project.godot` renderer, display, physics, and autoload settings.

## Unconfirmed

- No `AGENTS.md` exists at the repository root.
- `godot/effects/` does not exist yet; it will be created when Effect A or B is first built.
- The A5 editor-rewrite caveat (`project.godot`, `default_bus_layout.tres`, scenes) is
  assumed to still apply to A6 editor sessions; restore with git after each session
  (TEST-REPORT A5.8).
- CHANGE-BRIEF §B.3 plans moth emitters at x = 8, 12, 16, between the pole x-values
  (6, 10, 14, 18) from `deck_dressing.gd:11`, not on the bulbs themselves. The brief flags
  this for a re-check before building.

## Project context

- **Engine:** Godot 4.7.2.stable.official.ed1daf0bf, macOS (feature `"4.7"` at

  gameplay scene `res://scenes/slice.tscn` (root `Slice`, `Node3D` at `slice.tscn:78`).

### Effect A — Sand scuff on footsteps (scene in `godot/scenes/slice.tscn`)

- **Node type:** two `CPUParticles3D` emitters (SoftDust, FineGrit) under a `FootstepScuff`
  root, instanced per footfall. CPU, because the scuff only needs gravity, damping, colour,
  and scale; `CPUParticles3D` in this build has no `amount_ratio`, turbulence, or attractor
  (CHANGE-BRIEF §0).
- **Trigger owner:** Hari, a `CharacterBody3D` (`slice.tscn:236`, `godot/scenes/hari.gd`).
  Walked distance in `hari.gd:11,69,72` (`STRIDE_M = 0.42`, `_travel += speed * delta`);
  foot contact at `_travel / STRIDE_M` = 2k + 0.5 (`hari.gd:74-75`), ~0.38 s at

  the trigger must detect contact crossings itself. Gate on `Story.hari_state == "WALK"`
  (`godot/autoload/story.gd:25,60`) and `Story.movement_locked()` (respected at
  `hari.gd:43`); pause comes from the tree pause set by `Controls` on `pause`
  (`godot/autoload/controls.gd:19-20`; `godot/logic/input_setup.gd:13`).

### Effect B — Moths around the string lights (same scene)

- **Node type:** three `GPUParticles3D` emitters using a `ParticleProcessMaterial`, each
  paired with a `GPUParticlesAttractorSphere3D`. Chosen for `turbulence_*` and attractor
  interaction, which `CPUParticles3D` lacks here (CHANGE-BRIEF §0). The string lights
  (poles, bulbs, warm `OmniLight3D` per span) are built in code by
  `godot/scenes/deck_dressing.gd:11-13,42-46`, attached from `slice.tscn:91`.
- **Condition owner:** `LoopState.phase == Phase.NIGHT` (enum
  `godot/autoload/loop_state.gd:18`) and `LoopState.clock_minutes < 1740` (sky-lighten
  threshold `godot/scenes/slice.gd:28`; clock written at `loop_state.gd:59`). **No signal
  fires at minute 1740** — the controller must poll each frame. Pause uses the tree pause.

## Current change

@CHANGE-BRIEF.md

## Ownership

Files in `godot/shaders/` are hand-written by Shriram. An agent must never create, edit, or
rewrite any `.gdshader` file (both A5 shaders and the hint-experiment shader) or the one
`COLOR` line in `fragment()`. Agent sessions leave `git diff --stat godot/shaders/` empty.
The pixel predictions, hint-experiment predictions, colour line, and Part 3 short answers
in `CHANGE-BRIEF.md` (A5) are also Shriram's and aren't rewritten.

**A6 particle effects:** every per-emitter setting (emission, process, draw, turbulence,
attractor) lives in scene files under `godot/effects/` (`.tscn` + the `.tres` resources
they reference), **not** in code. Scripts in `godot/effects/` may trigger, position, show,
hide, pause, and free those instances, and may read `LoopState`/`Story`, but must not
construct `ParticleProcessMaterial`, curves, or ramps programmatically — the values from
CHANGE-BRIEF §A.3 and §B.3 belong in the scene.

## Godot 4 names

Use Godot 4 class and property names for 4.7.2, not Godot 3 names.

- **`ParticleProcessMaterial`**, not `ParticlesMaterial`. Ranges are min/max pairs:
  `initial_velocity_min/_max`, `scale_min/_max`, `damping_min/_max`, `hue_variation_min/_max`.
  Setting the Godot 3 scalar `initial_velocity` or `scale` leaves the min/max at 0 and the
  scene still loads silently (CHANGE-BRIEF §0). `scale_random` doesn't exist here.
- GPU node: **`GPUParticles3D`** (`amount_ratio`, `use_fixed_seed`, `seed`, `preprocess`,
  `visibility_aabb`, `trail_enabled`, `sub_emitter`). CPU: **`CPUParticles3D`** (no
  `amount_ratio`, turbulence, or attractor). Attractor: **`GPUParticlesAttractorSphere3D`**
  (`radius`, `strength`, `attenuation`, `directionality`).
- Material: **`StandardMaterial3D`** with `vertex_color_use_as_albedo`, `transparency`,
  `blend_mode`, `billboard_mode = BaseMaterial3D.BILLBOARD_PARTICLES` (= 3).

If I am unsure a property or enum exists in 4.7.2, I will say so in the response or in
"Unconfirmed" — not guess.

## Out of scope

The A6 change must not touch:

- Hari's movement, the 0.38 s footstep interval, collision, or input (`godot/scenes/hari.gd`,
  `godot/autoload/controls.gd`, `godot/logic/input_setup.gd`, `godot/logic/hari_spec.gd`).
- `LoopState` (`godot/autoload/loop_state.gd`) and `Story` (`godot/autoload/story.gd`)
  logic, phases, or the night clock rate. Particle controllers read these; they never write.
- Any A5 shader (`godot/shaders/`) or A5 material (`godot/materials/marble_dry.tres`,
  `marble_wet.tres`, `night_skip.tres`).
- `godot/scenes/deck_dressing.gd`, the string-light positions, bulbs, or warm `OmniLight3D`.
  Moths read those positions; they do not change them.
- Any existing test under `godot/tests/` or its expectations; `scripts/run-test.sh` (diff
  in every review); the known A2 wall-clock limitation in `Story._now()` (`story.gd:203`).
- Any HUD element, dialogue, toast, white-out, or 3D object other than the new effect
  scenes and the small trigger script that instantiates Effect A.
- `godot/project.godot` renderer, display, physics, and autoload settings.

## Unconfirmed

- No `AGENTS.md` exists at the repository root.
- `godot/effects/` does not exist yet; it will be created when Effect A or B is first built.
- The A5 editor-rewrite caveat (`project.godot`, `default_bus_layout.tres`, scenes) is
  assumed to still apply to A6 editor sessions; restore with git after each session
  (TEST-REPORT A5.8).
- CHANGE-BRIEF §B.3 plans moth emitters at x = 8, 12, 16, between the pole x-values
  (6, 10, 14, 18) from `deck_dressing.gd:11`, not on the bulbs themselves. The brief flags
  this for a re-check before building.

# CLAUDE.md

## Project context

- **Engine:** Godot 4.7.2.stable.official.ed1daf0bf, macOS (feature `"4.7"` at
  `godot/project.godot:16`; `README.md:6`). **Renderer:** Forward+ (`godot/project.godot:38`).
- **Main scene:** `res://scenes/intro.tscn` (`project.godot:15`). The A6 effects live in the
  gameplay scene `res://scenes/slice.tscn` (root `Slice`, `Node3D` at `slice.tscn:78`).

### Effect A — Sand scuff on footsteps (scene in `godot/scenes/slice.tscn`)

- **Node type:** two `CPUParticles3D` emitters (SoftDust, FineGrit) under a `FootstepScuff`
  root, instanced per footfall. CPU, because the scuff only needs gravity, damping, colour,
  and scale; `CPUParticles3D` in this build has no `amount_ratio`, turbulence, or attractor
  (CHANGE-BRIEF §0).
- **Trigger owner:** Hari, a `CharacterBody3D` (`slice.tscn:236`, `godot/scenes/hari.gd`).
  Walked distance in `hari.gd:11,69,72` (`STRIDE_M = 0.42`, `_travel += speed * delta`);
  foot contact at `_travel / STRIDE_M` = 2k + 0.5 (`hari.gd:74-75`), ~0.38 s at
  `WALK_SPEED = 2.2` (`godot/logic/hari_spec.gd:4,7`). **No footstep signal exists today** —
  the trigger must detect contact crossings itself. Gate on `Story.hari_state == "WALK"`
  (`godot/autoload/story.gd:25,60`) and `Story.movement_locked()` (respected at
  `hari.gd:43`); pause comes from the tree pause set by `Controls` on `pause`
  (`godot/autoload/controls.gd:19-20`; `godot/logic/input_setup.gd:13`).

### Effect B — Moths around the string lights (same scene)

- **Node type:** three `GPUParticles3D` emitters using a `ParticleProcessMaterial`, each
  paired with a `GPUParticlesAttractorSphere3D`. Chosen for `turbulence_*` and attractor
  interaction, which `CPUParticles3D` lacks here (CHANGE-BRIEF §0). The string lights
  (poles, bulbs, warm `OmniLight3D` per span) are built in code by
  `godot/scenes/deck_dressing.gd:11-13,42-46`, attached from `slice.tscn:91`.
- **Condition owner:** `LoopState.phase == Phase.NIGHT` (enum
  `godot/autoload/loop_state.gd:18`) and `LoopState.clock_minutes < 1740` (sky-lighten
  threshold `godot/scenes/slice.gd:28`; clock written at `loop_state.gd:59`). **No signal
  fires at minute 1740** — the controller must poll each frame. Pause uses the tree pause.

### Tests (all through `scripts/run-test.sh`)

`scripts/run-test.sh <file.gd> <fps|realtime> [timeout-seconds]` runs
`godot --headless --path godot --script res://tests/<file>`, adds `--fixed-fps <fps>` when
`$2` is numeric and omits it when `$2` is `realtime`; tees to `logs/<name>_<fps|realtime>.log`
and exits 1 on `SHADER ERROR`/`SCRIPT ERROR` (`scripts/run-test.sh:1-14`). Default timeout 120 s.

Current tests in `godot/tests/` (A6 baseline: `logs/a6-baseline/SUMMARY.txt`). The three
wall-clock A2 tests need `realtime`; others pass at any fps.

```bash
scripts/run-test.sh test_assets_present.gd 60        # 70/70       (A2)
scripts/run-test.sh test_audio_mix.gd 60             # 10/10       (A2)
scripts/run-test.sh test_sound_triggers.gd realtime  # 86/86  wall-clock; 53/86 at --fixed-fps 60
scripts/run-test.sh test_loop_logic.gd realtime      # 36/36  wall-clock; 4/36  at --fixed-fps 60
scripts/run-test.sh test_slice_smoke.gd realtime     # 13/13  wall-clock; 4/13  at --fixed-fps 60
scripts/run-test.sh check_a3_assets.gd 60            # 31/31       (A3)
scripts/run-test.sh check_a3_selftest.gd 60          # 17/17       (A3)
scripts/run-test.sh test_night_skip.gd 30            # 33/33  (A5; also at 60 and 144)
scripts/run-test.sh test_materials.gd 60             # 156/156     (A5)
scripts/run-test.sh normal_map_check.gd 60           # 11/11       (A5)
```

`harness.gd` is the shared base class; `a3_measure.gd`/`capture_a3.gd` are helpers, not
tests. New A6 tests (CHANGE-BRIEF §D) run through the same wrapper and must use frame
`delta`, never `Time.get_ticks_msec()`.

### Headless facts (confirmed on this machine)
- `godot` on PATH: `/opt/homebrew/bin/godot` → `~/Downloads/Godot.app/Contents/MacOS/Godot`
  (4.7.2.stable.official.ed1daf0bf). The README's `/Applications` path is wrong here.
  `timeout` is GNU coreutils at `/opt/homebrew/bin/timeout` (exit 124 = hung).
- Headless uses a dummy renderer: `GPUParticles3D` isn't GPU-simulated. It can read
  `can_process()`, `emitting`, `visible`, `amount`, `lifetime`, curves and material
  properties, but **never** the rendered picture. Every visual rule ends in a human check.
  Never add `--rendering-driver` to the wrapper.

## Current change

@CHANGE-BRIEF.md

## Ownership

Files in `godot/shaders/` are hand-written by Shriram. An agent must never create, edit, or
rewrite any `.gdshader` file (both A5 shaders and the hint-experiment shader) or the one
`COLOR` line in `fragment()`. Agent sessions leave `git diff --stat godot/shaders/` empty.
The pixel predictions, hint-experiment predictions, colour line, and Part 3 short answers
in `CHANGE-BRIEF.md` (A5) are also Shriram's and aren't rewritten.

**A6 particle effects:** every per-emitter setting (emission, process, draw, turbulence,
attractor) lives in scene files under `godot/effects/` (`.tscn` + the `.tres` resources
they reference), **not** in code. Scripts in `godot/effects/` may trigger, position, show,
hide, pause, and free those instances, and may read `LoopState`/`Story`, but must not
construct `ParticleProcessMaterial`, curves, or ramps programmatically — the values from
CHANGE-BRIEF §A.3 and §B.3 belong in the scene.

## Godot 4 names

Use Godot 4 class and property names for 4.7.2, not Godot 3 names.

- **`ParticleProcessMaterial`**, not `ParticlesMaterial`. Ranges are min/max pairs:
  `initial_velocity_min/_max`, `scale_min/_max`, `damping_min/_max`, `hue_variation_min/_max`.
  Setting the Godot 3 scalar `initial_velocity` or `scale` leaves the min/max at 0 and the
  scene still loads silently (CHANGE-BRIEF §0). `scale_random` doesn't exist here.
- GPU node: **`GPUParticles3D`** (`amount_ratio`, `use_fixed_seed`, `seed`, `preprocess`,
  `visibility_aabb`, `trail_enabled`, `sub_emitter`). CPU: **`CPUParticles3D`** (no
  `amount_ratio`, turbulence, or attractor). Attractor: **`GPUParticlesAttractorSphere3D`**
  (`radius`, `strength`, `attenuation`, `directionality`).
- Material: **`StandardMaterial3D`** with `vertex_color_use_as_albedo`, `transparency`,
  `blend_mode`, `billboard_mode = BaseMaterial3D.BILLBOARD_PARTICLES` (= 3).

If I am unsure a property or enum exists in 4.7.2, I will say so in the response or in
"Unconfirmed" — not guess.

## Out of scope

The A6 change must not touch:

- Hari's movement, the 0.38 s footstep interval, collision, or input (`godot/scenes/hari.gd`,
  `godot/autoload/controls.gd`, `godot/logic/input_setup.gd`, `godot/logic/hari_spec.gd`).
- `LoopState` (`godot/autoload/loop_state.gd`) and `Story` (`godot/autoload/story.gd`)
  logic, phases, or the night clock rate. Particle controllers read these; they never write.
- Any A5 shader (`godot/shaders/`) or A5 material (`godot/materials/marble_dry.tres`,
  `marble_wet.tres`, `night_skip.tres`).
- `godot/scenes/deck_dressing.gd`, the string-light positions, bulbs, or warm `OmniLight3D`.
  Moths read those positions; they do not change them.
- Any existing test under `godot/tests/` or its expectations; `scripts/run-test.sh` (diff
  in every review); the known A2 wall-clock limitation in `Story._now()` (`story.gd:203`).
- Any HUD element, dialogue, toast, white-out, or 3D object other than the new effect
  scenes and the small trigger script that instantiates Effect A.
- `godot/project.godot` renderer, display, physics, and autoload settings.

## Unconfirmed

- No `AGENTS.md` exists at the repository root.
- `godot/effects/` does not exist yet; it will be created when Effect A or B is first built.
- The A5 editor-rewrite caveat (`project.godot`, `default_bus_layout.tres`, scenes) is
  assumed to still apply to A6 editor sessions; restore with git after each session
  (TEST-REPORT A5.8).
- CHANGE-BRIEF §B.3 plans moth emitters at x = 8, 12, 16, between the pole x-values
  (6, 10, 14, 18) from `deck_dressing.gd:11`, not on the bulbs themselves. The brief flags
  this for a re-check before building.
